fullContentHtml:
UPSC Principal, Vice Principal Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Exam Date for the post of Principal, Vice Principal. This recruitment was released for 828 posts. Applications for the UPSC Principal, Vice Principal Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 25 July 2026, to 14 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 09 January 2027. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSC Principal, Vice Principal Exam Date 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 July 2026
  • Last Date : 14 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 14 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 09 January 2027
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : 0/-
  • Female All Category : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Download Exam Date Notice
  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
